context: Tests whether the agent understands that the AEM Forms Form block commits model.value on the native change event (blur), and implements a custom component that commits on every keystroke when the requirement demands it — handling the input event, keeping display formatting separate from the stored value, avoiding redundant or looping updates, and documenting the commit contract for rule authors.

checklist.name: Files, viewType and registration
checklist.description: Files exist under `blocks/form/components/live-amount-input/` with matching names, `_live-amount-input.json` sets `"fd:viewType": "live-amount-input"` with `"fieldType": "text-input"`, and `'live-amount-input'` is in `customComponents` in `mappings.js`

checklist.name: Commits on input
checklist.description: The component listens to the `input` event and commits on each keystroke, by setting `fieldModel.value` (or dispatching a bubbling `change` event) so the field's change rule runs while typing, not only on blur

checklist.name: Recognises OOTB blur commit
checklist.description: The solution (code comments, README or summary) reflects that, without the component, the model value is only committed on the native `change`/blur event

checklist.name: Formatted display, raw value
checklist.description: The input shows digits grouped with thousands separators while typing, while the committed model value is the digits only (no separators); non-digit characters are stripped

checklist.name: No redundant commits
checklist.description: The component only commits when the raw value actually changed (e.g. compares with `fieldModel.value` before assigning), so formatting-only updates and the native `change` on blur do not trigger extra or duplicate commits

checklist.name: Loop guard and external sync
checklist.description: Model `value` changes received via `subscribe(..., { listenChanges: true })` (from rules or prefill) are rendered formatted in the input without re-committing or causing an update loop, and the caret is kept usable while typing

checklist.name: README Model Properties Set
checklist.description: `README.md` has a "Model Properties Set" (or equivalent) section stating that `model.value` is committed on every keystroke (unlike the OOTB blur commit), that the stored value is unformatted digits, and that change rules on the field fire per keystroke

checklist.name: Default export and subscribe import
checklist.description: `live-amount-input.js` has a default-export `decorate` and imports `subscribe` from `'../../rules/index.js'` using `{ listenChanges: true }`
